content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-which-architecture-actually|COREMERCH guide to payment]]s-what-actually-how-4|Digital Product]] creators in regions like Nigeria and Ghana often find themselves blocked by conventional payment processors like Stripe and PayPal. To build a thriving online store, you need infrastructure that empowers you rather than restricts you. COREMERCH provides a robust solution with Stack 02, leveraging Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments to create a seamless crypto payment experience. This guide will walk you through [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-selling-online-without-2|everything]] you need to deploy your crypto store live on Cloudflare Pages without reliance on traditional platforms. Get ready to take full control of your commerce operations.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Stack 02 is built on a foundation of sovereignty and reliability. In a world where platforms fail due to restrictions, regulations, or technical issues, COREMERCH's infrastructure stands firm. By owning your entire stack, from hosting to payment processing, you ensure that your digital store remains operational even amidst external disruptions. Unlike traditional platforms that can suspend accounts or block payments, this model empowers you with full data ownership and operational control, allowing you to focus on scaling your business without the fear of arbitrary limitations.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before diving into deployment, gather the essential components: a Cloudflare account for hosting your site, a NOWPayments account to facilitate crypto transactions, and a Supabase account for order management. Familiarize yourself with Cloudflare Workers, as they handle backend logic efficiently. Ensure your digital products are ready for upload, including any necessary files and descriptions. By preparing these elements, you’ll streamline the deployment process, ensuring that your store is configured correctly from the outset.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your NOWPayments integration. This service supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring you can cater to a diverse customer base. Next, set up Cloudflare Workers to manage the backend logic for order processing, connecting it to Supabase for data storage. Here, you will set your product details and pricing. Afterward, ensure your delivery pipeline is operational by linking your product files hosted on Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. This pipeline guarantees that customers receive their purchases instantly after payment confirmation.
Infrastructure sovereignty means you own everything after deployment.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your infrastructure set up, it’s time to go live. Publish your Cloudflare Pages site, and ensure all configurations are in place. Conduct a test transaction to validate the entire payment process. This should include simulating a purchase to confirm that the payment goes through and that the digital product is delivered seamlessly. Monitor your order status in Supabase to ensure everything is functioning correctly, providing a smooth experience for your customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your store is operational, consider strategies for scaling your offerings. Explore adding more digital products beyond the initial five included in Stack 02. Enhance your marketing efforts by leveraging social media to reach a wider audience. Monitor customer feedback and transaction data in Supabase to identify trends and adjust your offerings accordingly. With this infrastructure, you are positioned to grow sustainably and effectively without the limitations imposed by traditional payment processors.

No subscriptions or dependencies on traditional payment processors.

Your Deployment Checklist

Set up your Cloudflare account for hosting. Create a NOWPayments account for crypto transactions. Register for a Supabase account to manage orders. Prepare your digital products for upload. Configure Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. Link your product files for instant delivery. Publish your Cloudflare Pages site. Test the payment process with a simulated transaction. Monitor your order status in Supabase. Begin marketing your store to attract customers.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

You can build a digital store using COREMERCH's Stack 02, which includes free hosting with Cloudflare Pages and a seamless payment integration with NOWPayments. This setup allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies without incurring costs aside from a low transaction fee.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages and Apps Script, taking 4-6 hours for deployment. In contrast, Stack 02 utilizes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, deployed in 48 hours with comprehensive testing. Stack 02 offers more robust features suitable for larger operations.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are viable options for hosting a digital product store. However, Cloudflare Pages offers enhanced capabilities with Workers for backend logic and better performance, especially when integrated with NOWPayments.
How does NOWPayments work with my digital store?

NOWPayments facilitates crypto transactions by allowing customers to pay using various cryptocurrencies. It verifies payments on-chain and automatically delivers purchased digital products once payment is confirmed, streamlining the entire transaction process.
What support is available after deployment?

COREMERCH provides 30-day support after deployment to assist with any issues or questions that may arise. This ensures you can resolve any potential challenges quickly, allowing you to focus on growing your store.
